rationale: Added 'network_status' as a standalone grouping dimension to group_comparison to enable separate in-network and out-of-network analysis. Plan now groups by provider_specialty, network_status, and their combination, computing all metrics (claim count, paid amounts, denial and fraud rates) for each dimension and combination. Denial rates computed over adjudicated_claims per the evolved skill; small-group threshold set to 30; all other components retained as they address feedback requirements.
changes_summary: Added 'network_status' to the group_by parameter of group_comparison (now ['provider_specialty', 'network_status', 'provider_specialty+network_status']) to compute metrics separately for in-network and out-of-network claims, directly addressing the missing network_status grouping dimension identified in feedback.
